findings.detail: The non-USD marker belongs to the Par/Shares column, but was stored as fair_value_currency for the Hamilton Thorne EUR row; Fair Value is in the dollar-denominated Fair Value column.
The non-USD marker belongs to the Par/Shares column, but was stored as fair_value_currency for the Sonar AUD row; Fair Value is in the dollar-denominated Fair Value column.

rationale: FX02 is a real data error. The source schedule header separates Par/Shares, Cost, and Fair Value. In the affected rows, EUR and AUD appear in the Par/Shares currency position, while the numeric fair value appears later under the Fair Value column. Footnote (4) also states the non-USD denominations apply to par amount or shares/units. Therefore the stored fair_value_currency values U_EUR and U_AUD are not supported by the source fair value cells.
